parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the failed connection event.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: MAC Address identifying the associated device (STA) that has attempted to connect.

parameters.name: StatusCode
parameters.description: Status Code set to a non-zero value that indicates the reason for association or authentication failure as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-50}}, or Status Code set to zero and {{param|ReasonCode}} provided.

parameters.name: ReasonCode
parameters.description: Reason Code indicating the reason the STA was disassociated or deauthenticated as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-49}}.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

object.description: This object describes the data provided with a failed connection event {{deprecated|2.17|because a corresponding USP event is defined instead}} {{obsoleted|2.19}}
